notes: READ 21 September 2026, 14 pages, dated 14 September 2026, from literature/sources/winkler-2026-admissible-qx1-sequences-2026-09-14.pdf. doi 10.13140/RG.2.2.35856.78086. This entry previously held no URL and recorded only the sandwich, from an OEIS comment. SETTING. For odd q >= 3, a_q(r) counts words in {q/2, 1/2} with exactly r factors q/2, every proper prefix product above 1 and the total below 1. For q = 3, 5, 7 these are A100982, A174795, A174796. With alpha_q = log2 q and m_r(q) = floor(r alpha_q), the cycle lemma gives the two Beatty passage bounds this register already carried, and he proves the equality criteria directly: the lower and upper equality orders are the denominators of the strict one-sided best approximations to log2 q, together all convergent and semiconvergent denominators, equivalently the strict record minima and maxima of the binary mantissas q^r / 2^(m_r). At every nontrivial equality order the words biject with rational Dyck paths and a_q(r) is a rational Catalan number. SECTION 7 IS THE PART THAT MATTERS, AND IT WAS NOT VISIBLE FROM THE OEIS COMMENT. Corollary 11 (Growth constants): lim_r a_q(r)^(1/r) = B_q = alpha^alpha / (alpha-1)^(alpha-1) at alpha = alpha_q, strictly increasing in q, with B_3 = 2.8395137305 for A100982. Corollary 12 (EXACT NORMALIZED OSCILLATION): with R_q(r) = r a_q(r) / binom(m_r(q)-1, r-1), liminf R_q = 1 and limsup R_q = alpha_q/(alpha_q - 1), the liminf attained exactly on the lower equality orders, the limsup approached along the upper ones through R_q(r) = m_r/(m_r - r + 1), and R_q(r) < alpha_q/(alpha_q - 1) strictly for all r >= 1. For q = 3 the upper envelope is 2.7095112914. WHAT THAT DOES AND DOES NOT DO TO PAPER B. It is an EXACT, TWO-SIDED, ATTAINED OSCILLATION WITH AN AMPLITUDE, for A100982 = M_d, published 14 September 2026. The prior-art note asserted that 'no source read in this audit states an oscillating prefactor, an amplitude, or anything equivalent'; as a blanket sentence that is now FALSE and has been narrowed. It is NOT the same statement as J-paper-b-meander-prefactor-is-almost-periodic: different object (M_d, not N_d), different normalisation (against the Beatty binomial, not against rho^d d^(-3/2)), and different form (an envelope with equality classification, not an almost-periodic function with a jump measure and a Fourier identity). The laboratory's claim survives, NARROWER, and it now has a named neighbour working the same mechanism -- the fluctuation being governed by the one-sided approximation of log2 3, i.e. by records of frac(r alpha). Anything written up must cite this corollary and say what it adds. Section 8 identifies the q = 3 equality-order set with A206788 and prints the q = 5 and q = 7 companions. He notes the whole paper avoids 'the broader marked-rotation machinery of [14]', which is winkler-2026-marked-rotations.
